# S62A - Transform master legacy cases into MPA schema tables
Reads the master file + mapping file, splits into one CSV per target table, writes them to a folder for ingestion.
Switch SOURCE to "s62a" once Spark can reach the S62A storage account.

# Parameters
SOURCE           = "highcourt_raw"   # "highcourt_raw" (ODW lake) or "s62a"
LOCAL_DIR        = None              # local folder with both xlsx files, for testing outside Synapse
FLATTEN_NEWLINES = True              # replace line breaks in text with " | " so CSVs are one line per row
KEEP_DATELESS_TEXT_AS_NOTE = False   # date fields holding text with no date: False = drop the text
NULL_COUNTS_TO_ZERO        = True    # blank counts/areas in parking, housing, floorspace, waste rows become 0

LOCATIONS = {
    "highcourt_raw": {
        "root":    "abfss://horizon-migration-poc@pinsstodwdevuks9h80mb.dfs.core.windows.net/S62A-MIGRATION",
        "master":  "MASTER LEGACY cases S62A - final.xlsx",
        "mapping": "Spreadsheet to MPA schema mapping.xlsx",
        "output":  "TRANSFORM",
        "key":     None,
    },
    "s62a": {
        "root":    "abfss://s62a@pinssts62adevukseftlkl.dfs.core.windows.net/PIPELINE",
        "master":  "INPUT/MASTER/MASTER LEGACY cases S62A - final.xlsx",
        "mapping": "INPUT/MAPPING/Spreadsheet to MPA schema mapping.xlsx",
        "output":  "OUTPUT/TRANSFORM",
        "key":     ("ls_kv", "S62A-Storage-Dev"),
    },
}

# Rows without a valid reference get a generated one: S62A/<year>/<number>
# Year comes from the first date found in REF_YEAR_COLUMNS.
# "continue": carry on the existing running number (highest current + 1), shared across years like the real refs
# "separate": own series from GENERATED_REF_START per year, so it can never clash with future real refs
GENERATE_MISSING_REFS = True
GENERATED_REF_MODE    = "continue"
GENERATED_REF_START   = 9001
REF_YEAR_COLUMNS      = ["Pre-app/Application received date", "Pre-app received date",
                         "Notification received date", "Expected submission date", "Created on"]

DATA_SHEET  = "Final selected"
HEADER_ROWS = 3
REF_PATTERN = r"^S62A/(\d{4})/(\d{4}|\d{7})(RD)?$"

# Imports
import os, re, csv, uuid
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd

LOC    = LOCATIONS[SOURCE]
RUN_TS = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
TMP    = "/tmp/s62a_transform"
os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)

# Load files
def fetch(rel_path):
    if LOCAL_DIR:
        return os.path.join(LOCAL_DIR, os.path.basename(rel_path))
    local = os.path.join(TMP, os.path.basename(rel_path))
    mssparkutils.fs.cp(f"{LOC['root']}/{rel_path}", f"file:{local}")
    return local

if not LOCAL_DIR:
    from notebookutils import mssparkutils
    if LOC["key"]:
        account = re.search(r"@([^.]+)\.dfs", LOC["root"]).group(1)
        key = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecretWithLS(*LOC["key"]).strip()
        spark.conf.set(f"fs.azure.account.key.{account}.dfs.core.windows.net", key)

master_path  = fetch(LOC["master"])
mapping_path = fetch(LOC["mapping"])

raw = pd.read_excel(master_path, sheet_name=DATA_SHEET, header=None, dtype=object)
fields = raw.iloc[1].astype(str).str.strip()
src = raw.iloc[HEADER_ROWS:].copy()
src.columns = fields
src = src.dropna(how="all").reset_index(drop=True)
src["Case reference"] = src["Case reference"].astype(str).str.strip()

mapping = pd.read_excel(mapping_path, sheet_name=0, dtype=str)
mapping.columns = ["source_column", "target_field", "target_table", "notes"][:len(mapping.columns)]
for c in ["source_column", "target_field", "target_table"]:
    mapping[c] = mapping[c].astype(str).str.strip().replace("nan", None)

print(f"Source: {SOURCE} | cases: {len(src)} | columns: {len(fields)} | mapping rows: {len(mapping)}")

# 1. Flat 1:1 tables driven by the mapping file (S62aCase, S62aDates, S62aFees)
FLAT_TABLES = ["S62aCase", "S62aDates", "S62aFees"]
SPECIAL = {  # handled explicitly below
    "Case reference", "Pre-application status", "Application Status", "Pre-app/Application received date",
}
flat_map = mapping[mapping.target_table.isin(FLAT_TABLES) & mapping.target_field.notna()]
note_cols = flat_map[flat_map.target_field == "Notes"].source_column.tolist()
flat_map = flat_map[(flat_map.target_field != "Notes") & ~flat_map.source_column.isin(SPECIAL)]

CUSTOM_COLUMNS = {   # used by the explicit builders below, even if the mapping has no target
    "ParkingGroupID", "ParkingSpaceDifference", "NonResGroupID", "WasteMaxThroughputType",
    "TotalProposedResidentialUnits", "NetResidentialUnitChange", "NetAdditionalFloorspaceSqM",
    "NonResExistingFloorspaceSqM", "NonResFloorspaceLostSqM", "NonResFloorspaceProposedSqM", "NonResNetFloorspaceSqM",
}
KNOWN_TABLES = set(FLAT_TABLES) | {"Lpa", "Contact", "Address", "S62aToApplicant", "S62aCaseInspector", "S62aEvent",
                                   "S62aVehicleParking", "S62aNonResidentialFloorspace",
                                   "S62aNonResidentialFloorspaceArea", "S62aResidentialHousing", "S62aCaseWasteType"}
for _, m in mapping.iterrows():
    c = m.source_column
    if c in CUSTOM_COLUMNS or c in SPECIAL or c not in cases.columns:
        continue
    if m.target_table in KNOWN_TABLES:
        continue
    has_data = cases[c].map(lambda v: not blank(v)).any()
    if has_data:
        log(None, "mapping", c, f"{m.target_table}.{m.target_field}", "Has data but no valid target in mapping, not migrated")
    else:
        log(None, "mapping", c, f"{m.target_table}.{m.target_field}", "No target in mapping, but column is empty so nothing lost", "INFO")

tables = {t: [] for t in FLAT_TABLES}
for _, row in cases.iterrows():
    ref = row["Case reference"]
    recs = {t: {"caseReference": ref} for t in FLAT_TABLES}

    for _, m in flat_map.iterrows():
        v = get(row, m.source_column)
        field = re.sub(r"\s+", "", m.target_field)
        recs[m.target_table][field] = to_date(v, ref, m.target_table, m.source_column) if is_date_field(field) else clean(v)

    # pre-app vs application: use Application phase, fall back to reference format
    phase = str(get(row, "Application phase") or "").strip().lower()
    is_pre = phase == "pre-application" or (phase in ("", "nan") and row._ref_class == "PRE_APP")

    # status: pre-app status for pre-app cases, else application status
    pre_s, app_s = clean(get(row, "Pre-application status")), clean(get(row, "Application Status"))
    recs["S62aCase"]["S62aStatus"] = (pre_s or app_s) if is_pre else app_s

    # combined received date -> pre-app or application field (dedicated pre-app column wins)
    rd = to_date(get(row, "Pre-app/Application received date"), ref, "S62aDates", "Pre-app/Application received date")
    target = "preApplicationReceivedDate" if is_pre else "applicationReceivedDate"
    if rd and not recs["S62aDates"].get(target):
        recs["S62aDates"][target] = rd


    for t in FLAT_TABLES:
        tables[t].append(recs[t])

# 1c. Case-level development totals (in the file, flagged "Add to schema" in the mapping)
TOTALS = {"TotalProposedResidentialUnits": "totalProposedResidentialUnits",
          "NetResidentialUnitChange": "netResidentialUnitChange",
          "NetAdditionalFloorspaceSqM": "netAdditionalFloorspaceSqM",
          "NonResExistingFloorspaceSqM": "nonResExistingFloorspaceSqM",
          "NonResFloorspaceLostSqM": "nonResFloorspaceLostSqM",
          "NonResFloorspaceProposedSqM": "nonResFloorspaceProposedSqM",
          "NonResNetFloorspaceSqM": "nonResNetFloorspaceSqM"}
totals_rows = []
for _, row in cases.iterrows():
    rec = {"caseReference": row["Case reference"], **{f: clean(get(row, c)) for c, f in TOTALS.items()}}
    if any(rec[f] is not None for f in TOTALS.values()):
        totals_rows.append(rec)
tables["S62aCaseTotals"] = totals_rows

# 2. LPAs (primary + secondary)
lpa_rows = []
for _, row in cases.iterrows():
    for role, prefix in [("Primary", "LPA"), ("Secondary", "Secondary LPA")]:
        lpa = get(row, prefix)
        if blank(lpa):
            continue
        first = get(row, f"{prefix} - First name") if f"{prefix} - First name" in row.index else get(row, f"{prefix}  - First name")
        last  = get(row, f"{prefix} - Last name")
        phone = get(row, f"{prefix} - Phone number") if f"{prefix} - Phone number" in row.index else get(row, f"{prefix}  - Phone number")
        email = get(row, f"{prefix} - Email") if f"{prefix} - Email" in row.index else get(row, f"{prefix}  - Email")
        name = " ".join(str(clean(x)) for x in (first, last) if not blank(x)) or None
        lpa_rows.append({"caseReference": row["Case reference"], "lpaRole": role, "lpa": clean(lpa),
                         "contactName": name, "telephoneNumber": clean(phone),
                         "email": clean(re.sub(r"^mailto:", "", str(email), flags=re.I)) if not blank(email) else None})
tables["S62aCaseLpa"] = lpa_rows

# 4. Inspectors (1-3)
insp_rows = []
for _, row in cases.iterrows():
    for i in (1, 2, 3):
        user = get(row, f"Inspector {i}")
        if blank(user):
            continue
        insp_rows.append({"caseReference": row["Case reference"], "inspectorNumber": i, "user": clean(user),
                          "appointedDate": to_date(get(row, f"Date Inspector ({i}) allocated"), row["Case reference"],
                                                   "S62aCaseInspector", f"Date Inspector ({i}) allocated")})
tables["S62aCaseInspector"] = insp_rows
# 7. Notes table (note columns + text pulled out of date fields)
tables["S62aCaseNote"] = note_rows + [n for n in extra_notes if n["caseReference"]]

# 7b. GUID keys: S62aCase.id is the PK, every other table gets its own id PK + caseId FK
# uuid5 = deterministic: same case reference (and row position) always gives the same GUID, so reruns are stable
GUID_NAMESPACE = uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, "pins-s62a-migration")

def make_guid(*parts):
    return str(uuid.uuid5(GUID_NAMESPACE, "|".join(str(p) for p in parts))).upper()

case_ids = {ref: make_guid("S62aCase", ref) for ref in cases["Case reference"]}
relationships = []
for t, rows in tables.items():
    if not rows:
        continue
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if t == "S62aCase":
        frame.insert(0, "id", frame["caseReference"].map(case_ids))
        relationships.append({"table": t, "primaryKey": "id", "foreignKey": None, "references": None, "relationship": "parent"})
    else:
        pos = frame.groupby("caseReference").cumcount() + 1
        frame.insert(0, "id", [make_guid(t, r, n) for r, n in zip(frame["caseReference"], pos)])
        frame.insert(1, "caseId", frame["caseReference"].map(case_ids))
        one_to_one = frame["caseReference"].is_unique and t in ("S62aDates", "S62aFees", "S62aCaseTotals")
        relationships.append({"table": t, "primaryKey": "id", "foreignKey": "caseId", "references": "S62aCase.id",
                              "relationship": "1 to 1" if one_to_one else "1 to many"})
    missing_fk = frame["caseReference"].map(case_ids).isna().sum() if t != "S62aCase" else 0
    assert missing_fk == 0, f"{t}: {missing_fk} rows with no parent case"
    assert frame["id"].is_unique, f"{t}: duplicate GUIDs"
    tables[t] = frame.to_dict("records")
relationships_df = pd.DataFrame(relationships)
print(relationships_df.to_string(index=False))

# 8. Summary
summary = pd.DataFrame([{"table": t, "rows": len(r), "columns": len(pd.DataFrame(r).columns) if r else 0}
                        for t, r in tables.items()])
exceptions_df = pd.DataFrame(exceptions, columns=["severity", "caseReference", "table", "column", "value", "issue"])
exceptions_df.insert(1, "caseId", exceptions_df["caseReference"].map(case_ids))
print(summary.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nExceptions: {len(exceptions_df)}")
print(exceptions_df.groupby(["severity", "issue"]).size().to_string())
